column1: # (Qieyun 韻, 聲) -> 平水韻部 and 詞林正韻部. ONE row per cell of
# data/qieyun_mc.tsv; that file is not modified by this one.
# WHY TWO STANDARDS IN ONE FILE. 平水韻 (1252) is the standard for 詩;
# 詞林正韻 (戈載, 1821) codifies the practice of 詞, which merges 上 with 去
# inside a 部 and holds the five 入聲 部 apart. They are different answers to
# the same question and quality/phonology/ltc.py makes the choice a declared
# coordinate (doctrine 45), so both have to be on disk to be chosen between.
# SOURCE  hulbji/couyun, MIT (LICENSE at repo root, covers the repository),
#         couyun/hanzi/hanzi_class.py: 115 character lists, each tagged with
#         its 聲, its 平水韻部 and its 詞林韻部. Reached by
# DERIVATION  couyun records the 部 per CHARACTER, because that is how both
#         rhyme books are printed. This module's phonology is a rime-book
#         lookup keyed on (韻, 聲), so the partition is compressed onto that
#         key by majority vote over characters that are UNAMBIGUOUS on both
#         sides -- exactly one reading in data/qieyun_mc.tsv, exactly one
#         couyun list, and agreeing on 聲. 12,289 characters vote.
#         The compression is LOSSY and the loss is recorded, not assumed:
#         every row carries the purity of its vote. Rows below 0.95 are the
#         韻 the tradition splits LEXICALLY (泰 by 開合, 佳 between 第五部 and
#         第十部) and a (韻,聲)-keyed table cannot represent that. Doctrine 36
#         one rung further in: the granularity a reference work records is
#         not the granularity a form works at, and that is true of THIS table
#         as much as of the Qieyun.
#         Keying on (韻, 聲, 開合) instead was measured: 0.9897 against 0.9871,
#         for 356 cells instead of 196 and cells with support 3. Rejected by
#         doctrine 61 -- +0.26pp of purity is not worth a rule that fires on
# INDEPENDENCE (doctrine 13)  couyun is a rhyme-lookup tool. Its per-character
#         assignment was written with no reference to 花間集, to the 欽定詞譜
#         alignment this partition is scored against, or to anything in this
#         repository. It is independent of the corpus it is measured on.
#         What it is NOT independent of: the 欽定詞譜's own 韻 markers were
#         placed by 1715 editors who knew which characters rhymed in 詞
#         practice, and 詞林正韻 (1821) codified that same practice. So a high
#         agreement between them is evidence that the SPEC agrees with the 詞
#         codification rather than the 詩 one -- which is the claim being made
#         -- and not independent evidence that either is correct.
# pingshui_bu / cilin_bu are couyun's signed integers, kept verbatim so a row
# can be checked against the source without a decoder: POSITIVE is 平聲,
# NEGATIVE is 上/去 (which is why 上 and 去 of one 部 compare equal under
# 詞林正韻), and cilin_bu 15..19 are the five 入聲 部.
# purity/support describe the cilin vote; ps_purity/ps_support the 平水 vote.
# An empty bu is a cell no clean character voted on: the module REFUSES there
